Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in Step 3 by incorrectly deducing that the Vice President associated with Nelson Rockefeller is Spiro Agnew. Nelson Rockefeller was the Vice President under Richard Nixon (1974), not Spiro Agnew. Spiro Agnew was Vice President under Richard Nixon (1969–1973). The Planner failed to verify the historical relationship between Rockefeller and the Vice Presidency, leading to the wrong answer.
